title: The Cliffside Cage Sale
story: On the wind-blown ledges of the Sky Bazaar, Hobbright the Songcage Peddler dangles five wicker cages of thunder-sparrows, whose songs make the storms behave. Mr 6 wants to buy every cage and set the birds free. Hobbright grins, licks his pencil, and begins inventing prices.
question: Each cage costs 12 ember coins. Hobbright gives 25% off the total for buying all 5 cages, then adds a 10% perch tax to the discounted total. How many ember coins must Mr 6 pay?
solution: Adding the 10% perch tax: 45 × 1.1 = 49.5 ember coins.
praise: Working the discount first was the smart order — the perch tax just needed one more multiply on top.
hint: Find the plain total first, then take the discount, and only THEN put the tax on the new, smaller price.
victory: Mr 6 counted out 49.5 ember coins exactly, and when the cages sprang open the thunder-sparrows sang a chord so bright that Hobbright's pencil snapped in surprise.
imagePrompt: A cheerful armored numeral 6 counting glowing coins on a windy cliffside market ledge while a lanky peddler holds five wicker cages of crackling blue sparrows above a sea of clouds at sunset.
